upload.title: Upload to {workspace}
upload.description: Uploaded files belong to {workspace}: they stay when you leave, and admins manage them. To share a file and keep it yours, share it from your files instead.
upload.formats: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown or text · up to {limit} each
upload.tooBig: {count, plural, one {{names} is over {limit} and was left out.} other {{names} are over {limit} and were left out.}}

connect.title: Connect a source
connect.description: A shared drive, wiki or site {workspace} already keeps its documents in. It stays in sync, belongs to the workspace, and Leo answers from it for whoever you choose.
connect.linkHint: The folder, space or page to keep in sync.

share.title: Share from my files
share.description: Leo answers from them in {workspace} for whoever you choose. They stay in your File Manager, stay yours, and leave with you.
